articles.content:
🆕 SPORE

- Version: v0.1
- Full
------------
This is an unofficial port of SPORE for Android with touchscreen controls. Enjoy the game!

Installation Guide:
1. Copy the "Spore" folder to the root of the phone's internal storage, so you get Internal storage/Spore/SporebinEP1/SporeApp.exe (the path is /sdcard/Spore).
2. Install spore.apk (allow installing from unknown sources if Android asks).
3. Start "Spore". When it asks for file access, allow "All files access" - the game reads its files from /sdcard/Spore.
4. The first start takes a while (it builds the galaxy and shader caches).

articles.content:
🛡 About recent security warnings

Some users have reported security warnings while installing APKs from our website. Apps downloaded outside Google Play may undergo additional security checks. When a scanner flags a file, its warning can use standard wording mentioning SMS, payments or personal data.

This wording can sound alarming, but the message alone does not prove that these actions happened on your phone. False positives are possible, including with modified APKs, but each warning needs individual review.

How we prepare files at APKVision

• Our own mods: we obtain original apps from Google Play, purchasing them when required, and modify those files ourselves. These builds are prepared directly by our team.

• Android ports from other developers: we scan the files for malware and perform additional code checks using analysis tools.

• Our update notifier: some builds include a banner that checks our servers for newer versions. Its code is obfuscated to protect it from modification. Modified APKs are also re-signed. These changes can affect automated analysis, but they do not automatically explain every detection.

False positives can also appear in VirusTotal reports. The number of detections alone cannot confirm whether a file is safe.

How the website is funded

Our only income comes from advertising on the website’s download pages, including pop-up ads that open in a new tab. We understand that this format can be annoying.

Unfortunately, our niche limits access to mainstream advertising networks, and we currently have no viable alternative to cover our servers, cloud storage and other operating expenses. We appreciate your understanding.

We do not add malware or system-level adware to APKs. Our project depends on your trust and continued visits—distributing harmful files would undermine everything we’re building.

💬 We check our files before publication and take their safety seriously.

Ultimately, the decision to install is always yours.
